2034-6277-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-6968-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-2577-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
728-2577-6664-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

277-2438-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2438-2577-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

243-628-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
243-628-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7727.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7727.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-3446-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-6996-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6996-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1574-2523-2869.description:
Cast Rot-Tide Gargantua by paying its mana cost.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua dies, its second ability and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Rot-Tide Gargantua trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a token copy of Rot-Tide Gargantua that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Rot-Tide Gargantua token instead.

206-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2469-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2469-5220-5931-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

891-2292-2730.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4120-4186-6797-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
4120-4186-6797-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

366-3490-4369-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
366-3490-4369-5231.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Purphoros triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1086-2919-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-2919-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4676-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

888-2341-3649.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
888-2341-3649.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying The Peregrine Dynamo's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Peregrine Dynamo triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

1942-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
1942-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-4558-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-4558-6797.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

539-2436-4657.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Marwyn.
Repeat.

856-2034-2279-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-2279-4321.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2511-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2511-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

2921-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

851-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3946-4426-5447.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

190-202-3672-4591.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich, and lose life equal to their life totals due to Lich's effect.
You cannot lose the game due to having 0 or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Cast Cleanfall by paying {2}{W}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

662-1543-2984-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Ugin has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
662-1543-2984-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Ugin to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Ugin.
Activate Ugin by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2092-2816-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-2816-4289.description:
Activate the creature with Umbral Mantle attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the creature by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2232-2312-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a red nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {R}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact red permanent with mana cost {R} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
2232-2312-4740.description:
Cast the red permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Instinct and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Instinct trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The red permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact red permanent with mana cost {R} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

933-2493-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
